name: Cube Against Cancer Franklin 2026
information: **This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CACFranklin2026#67811-cube-against-cancercubeassociation.org) tab for more information.** This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CACFranklin2026#67812-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
